title: Chimichurri
description: A bright, herb-forward chimichurri with flat-leaf parsley, garlic, red wine vinegar, oregano, chile flakes, and extra-virgin olive oil.
ingredients: 60 g flat-leaf parsley, finely chopped and packed
0.2 g red pepper flakes, or to taste
steps: Finely chop the parsley and garlic. Combine them with the kosher salt and mash or stir firmly for 30–60 seconds to bruise the herbs and begin macerating the garlic.
Stir in the oregano, red pepper flakes, and red wine vinegar. Add the optional lemon juice if using.

Slowly stir in the olive oil until the sauce is loose and evenly combined. If using a Bamix or other immersion blender, pulse the parsley, garlic, salt, oregano, and chile only briefly until coarse, then stir in the vinegar and oil by hand or with only minimal pulses. Do not purée or emulsify it into a pesto-like sauce.
Let the chimichurri rest at least 20–30 minutes, ideally 30–60 minutes, before serving. Taste and adjust salt, vinegar, or chile as needed.
notes: Keep the texture coarse and spoonable. The optional lemon is a variation we liked while retaining the full red wine vinegar amount.
